entries.dialogueText: Suddenly, I felt a tap on the shoulder. I turned around to see Daria de Rava.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Baroness de Rava. How is your fami..."
entries.dialogueText: "Baroness de Rava. How is your family?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Who dares tap the shoulder of the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Who dares tap the shoulder of the King of Rizia?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Now is not a good time. I'm really..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now is not a good time. I'm really quite tired."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Madam Speaker. Just the person I'v..."
entries.dialogueText: "Madam Speaker. Just the person I've been looking to talk to."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Ah, the leader of the RNC. Just th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ah, the leader of the RNC. Just the person I've been looking to talk to."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She didn't smile."
entries.dialogueText: She didn't smile.

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Likewise. Can we speak privately?""
entries.dialogueText: "Likewise. Can we speak privately?"

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""I only need a minute, Your Majesty..."
entries.dialogueText: "I only need a minute, Your Majesty. It's rather important."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Can we speak privately?""
entries.dialogueText: "Can we speak privately?"

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""I didn't realize hierarchies were..."
entries.dialogueText: "I didn't realize hierarchies were so important to you, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Very well, Your Majesty. It's been..."
entries.dialogueText: "Very well, Your Majesty. It's been a spectacular evening."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If you insist. Let's go to the tro..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you insist. Let's go to the trophy room."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Anything you have to say to me, yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Anything you have to say to me, you can safely say to the other guests gathered in this room."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She gave me a look of warning."
entries.dialogueText: She gave me a look of warning.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My apologies, but I have other peo..."
entries.dialogueText: "My apologies, but I have other people to talk to. Have a good evening."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I motioned for the servers to begin..."
entries.dialogueText: I motioned for the servers to begin clearing everything away.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My mother walked over to stand next..."
entries.dialogueText: My mother walked over to stand next to me.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""A little premature to be kicking o..."
entries.dialogueText: "A little premature to be kicking our guests out, isn't it, darling?"

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Your cousin Hubertus looks like he..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your cousin Hubertus looks like he's just itching to speak with you."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""What will your wife say if she fin..."
entries.dialogueText: "What will your wife say if she finds out you never greeted your in-laws?"

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""House Azaro didn't come all this w..."
entries.dialogueText: "House Azaro didn't come all this way just for the appetizers, you know."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Poor Leona Sazon came all by herse..."
entries.dialogueText: "Poor Leona Sazon came all by herself. She could use someone to talk to."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""The Sazons are off in the corner w..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Sazons are off in the corner with no one to talk to. You could at least exchange a few words."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't care. These functions are..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't care. These functions are torture."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Fine, you win. One more round of g..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fine, you win. One more round of glad-handing it is."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'll embarrass myself if I keep ru..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll embarrass myself if I keep running my mouth off to everyone. Better to remain a monarch of mystery."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Have you seen what's happening out..."
entries.dialogueText: "Have you seen what's happening outside? I can't keep making small talk while the kingdom is in crisis."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Mother nodded in satisfaction."
entries.dialogueText: Mother nodded in satisfaction.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Off you go.""
entries.dialogueText: "Off you go."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She shrugged."
entries.dialogueText: She shrugged.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""It's all the same to me.""
entries.dialogueText: "It's all the same to me."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""One more transparently insincere a..."
entries.dialogueText: "One more transparently insincere attempt at flattery, and I would've gone to hide in the toilet."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""I couldn't bear to listen to one m..."
entries.dialogueText: "I couldn't bear to listen to one more backhanded comment about your... special status."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""All your worries were overblown. O..."
entries.dialogueText: "All your worries were overblown. Our relatives accept me exactly as I am."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I suppose it was rude of me to tur..."
entries.dialogueText: "I suppose it was rude of me to turn your big day into my coming-out party."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You were right. Rizia wasn't ready..."
entries.dialogueText: "You were right. Rizia wasn't ready for a same-sex partnership on the throne."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Last call, is it? Thank goodness.""
entries.dialogueText: "Last call, is it? Thank goodness."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Daria took a long look at me, then..."
entries.dialogueText: Daria took a long look at me, then bowed.

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""You too, Your Majesty. All my best..."
entries.dialogueText: "You too, Your Majesty. All my best to the Queen Mother."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She walked away to talk to one of t..."
entries.dialogueText: She walked away to talk to one of the other nobles.

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""That isn't true, and you know it.""
entries.dialogueText: "That isn't true, and you know it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She gave a terse nod and motioned f..."
entries.dialogueText: She gave a terse nod and motioned for me to follow her.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We walked into the trophy room, and..."
entries.dialogueText: We walked into the trophy room, and I shut the door behind us.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Daria stood stock-still as she spok..."
entries.dialogueText: Daria stood stock-still as she spoke.

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Your Majesty... speaking to the ot..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty... speaking to the other guests at this gathering, I've gotten the impression that certain suspicions have begun to circulate."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If you're referring to my orientat..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you're referring to my orientation, you must know that's no longer a secret."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Suspicions about what?""
entries.dialogueText: "Suspicions about what?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's awfully vague. Care to elab..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's awfully vague. Care to elaborate?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Who have you been talking to? Tell..."
entries.dialogueText: "Who have you been talking to? Tell me, and I'll have them beheaded on the spot."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She hesitated."
entries.dialogueText: She hesitated.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She winced."
entries.dialogueText: She winced.

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""That's not what I'm referring to...."
entries.dialogueText: "That's not what I'm referring to. Though it's also one of tonight's hotly discussed topics..."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""I'll be blunt. The RNC may not be..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll be blunt. The RNC may not be the majority in the House of Delegates anymore, but it is still a slap in the face to attempt reforms without consulting me or my party."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""It doesn't matter, Your Majesty...""
entries.dialogueText: "It doesn't matter, Your Majesty..."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""I'll be blunt. The RNC still const..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll be blunt. The RNC still constitutes a majority in the House of Delegates. You can't simply attempt reforms without consulting me or my party."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What are you talking about? I have..."
entries.dialogueText: "What are you talking about? I have no intention of attempting reforms."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I can and I will. It's too late fo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can and I will. It's too late for you or anyone else in the RNC to stop me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You and your party have been again..."
entries.dialogueText: "You and your party have been against reforms from day one. Why would I consult you?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Watch what you say. You wouldn't w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Watch what you say. You wouldn't want to end this perfectly lovely evening in a prison cell."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The RNC is no longer relevant. I'm..."
entries.dialogueText: "The RNC is no longer relevant. I'm acting according to the wishes of the real people of Rizia."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""The nobility is real enough, Your..."
entries.dialogueText: "The nobility is real enough, Your Majesty. And from what's being said out there, they pose a danger."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""That would only give more ammuniti..."
entries.dialogueText: "That would only give more ammunition to the people out there who want to overthrow you."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""We don't have time for games, Your..."
entries.dialogueText: "We don't have time for games, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Because we're the only buffer betw..."
entries.dialogueText: "Because we're the only buffer between you and those in this room who would overthrow you."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""What about the nobility, Your Maje..."
entries.dialogueText: "What about the nobility, Your Majesty? There's a reason you've been keeping your intentions a secret."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""If you want, the RNC and I can run..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you want, the RNC and I can run interference. Prevent your would-be usurpers from finding out your true plans until it's too late."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Once and for all, what plans? The..."
entries.dialogueText: "Once and for all, what plans? The people you're talking to are spreading lies about me behind my back."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""There's no need, Ms. de Rava. The..."
entries.dialogueText: "There's no need, Ms. de Rava. The other houses wouldn't dare go against my plans, anyway."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And what would you want in exchang..."
entries.dialogueText: "And what would you want in exchange for this act of kindness?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The corners of her lips turned up."
entries.dialogueText: The corners of her lips turned up.

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""All I want is to keep my job, Your..."
entries.dialogueText: "All I want is to keep my job, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""I only want a small promotion, You..."
entries.dialogueText: "I only want a small promotion, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Are you absolutely sure about that?""
entries.dialogueText: "Are you absolutely sure about that?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She sighed."
entries.dialogueText: She sighed.

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Whatever you say. Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Whatever you say. Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""If you want, the RNC and I can run..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you want, the RNC and I can run interference. Prevent your would-be usurpers from finding out your true plans until it's too late."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If you were to do so, I would make..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you were to do so, I would make sure you were duly rewarded."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""And I, in turn, would not let that..."
entries.dialogueText: "And I, in turn, would not let that reward go to waste."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Allow me to oversee the coming tra..."
entries.dialogueText: "Allow me to oversee the coming transition. Appoint me as prime minister."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""As majority leader of the House of..."
entries.dialogueText: "As majority leader of the House of Delegates, I should be the one to oversee the coming transition. As Prime Minister."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The reform movement leader is Adar..."
entries.dialogueText: "The reform movement leader is Adarfo Sotelato. He must be the one to shepherd the transition."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Manus is the one leading the refor..."
entries.dialogueText: "Manus is the one leading the reform movement. He must be the one to shepherd the transition."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That decision is out of my hands...."
entries.dialogueText: "That decision is out of my hands. I'm sorry."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You realize that this would only b..."
entries.dialogueText: "You realize that this would only be an interim position. That the people will soon vote for their new leader."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I can think of nobody more qualifi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can think of nobody more qualified. It would be an honor to have you fill that role."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""I would never move against you. Bu..."
entries.dialogueText: "I would never move against you. But if one of the other houses got my relatives involved, I wouldn't be able to stop them."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""All right, I'm listening. Tell me..."
entries.dialogueText: "All right, I'm listening. Tell me what you want."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We are done here. I highly suggest..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are done here. I highly suggest you leave this gathering immediately."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I appreciate your concern. But I n..."
entries.dialogueText: "I appreciate your concern. But I neither need nor want any help from you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She shook her head."
entries.dialogueText: She shook her head.

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""The man is good at getting people'..."
entries.dialogueText: "The man is good at getting people's attention. But what will happen once he has it? Does he realize actual leadership involves more than chanting and throwing rocks?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She shook her head."
entries.dialogueText: She shook her head.

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""The nobles view him as a traitor,..."
entries.dialogueText: "The nobles view him as a traitor, and he'll never truly be one of the common people. He may be a good figurehead now, but as a leader, can he keep Rizia together?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She shook her head in disappointmen..."
entries.dialogueText: She shook her head in disappointment.

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""That may be so. But somebody's got..."
entries.dialogueText: "That may be so. But somebody's got to keep the kingdom from falling apart in the months leading to the new elections."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A smile spread across her face."
entries.dialogueText: A smile spread across her face.

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Then I wish you the best of luck.""
entries.dialogueText: "Then I wish you the best of luck."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm glad we could come to this agr..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm glad we could come to this agreement. And just so you know, I will act soon."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Sotelato is already compromising b..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sotelato is already compromising by agreeing to keep the monarchy in place. If I don't appoint him prime minister, there'll be hell to pay."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""We should get back out there befor..."
entries.dialogueText: "We should get back out there before people start talking."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The best I can do is try to get yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "The best I can do is try to get you a ministry position in the new government. Will you accept that?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your party lost the last elections..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your party lost the last elections. You're not the leader the people of Rizia want."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your party is only the majority be..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your party is only the majority because of a rigged electoral system. You're not the leader the people of Rizia want."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She pursed her lips impatiently."
entries.dialogueText: She pursed her lips impatiently.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're not in a position to be mak..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're not in a position to be making demands, Ms. De Rava. I suggest you leave now."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She thought for a moment."
entries.dialogueText: She thought for a moment.

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Hm. I remember a time when the Kin..."
entries.dialogueText: "Hm. I remember a time when the King of Rizia didn't subjugate himself to the demands of coal miners."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""But whatever you say, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "But whatever you say, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Can you promise me I'll have a pro..."
entries.dialogueText: "Can you promise me I'll have a proper say in decision-making? Nothing symbolic."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""I'm afraid not.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm afraid not."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will make sure of it.""
entries.dialogueText: "I will make sure of it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No, I can't promise that.""
entries.dialogueText: "No, I can't promise that."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""As Rizia's most powerful elected r..."
entries.dialogueText: "As Rizia's most powerful elected representative, this role should be mine by default."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Rigged is in the eye of the behold..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rigged is in the eye of the beholder."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She pursed her lips impatiently."
entries.dialogueText: She pursed her lips impatiently.

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""I've spent half my life in service..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've spent half my life in service to Rizia Imperii and the Rizian Crown. Shouldn't that count for anything?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes, and I'll make sure you still..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, and I'll make sure you still have a role to play in the Rizian government. Just not that of prime minister."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She took another moment, then nodde..."
entries.dialogueText: She took another moment, then nodded.

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Then I will do what I can to make..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then I will do what I can to make sure your plan succeeds."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Then I really don't see the point..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then I really don't see the point in this conversation."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She took a step back."
entries.dialogueText: She took a step back.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If you want it that badly, it's yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you want it that badly, it's yours. You'll just lose it in a few months anyway."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""We will see about that.""
entries.dialogueText: "We will see about that."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A smile spread across her face."
entries.dialogueText: A smile spread across her face.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I need these reforms to succeed mo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I need these reforms to succeed more than anything. I'm willing to grant you the interim prime minister position if you help pacify the nobles."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Thank you, Your Majesty. I will do..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Your Majesty. I will do what I can to make sure your plan succeeds."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It should be, I agree. But there i..."
entries.dialogueText: "It should be, I agree. But there is nothing I can do."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your entitlement is astounding. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your entitlement is astounding. I suggest you leave this gathering before I have you booted out."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She looked at me disbelievingly."
entries.dialogueText: She looked at me disbelievingly.

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Gladly, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Gladly, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""If you'll please excuse me.""
entries.dialogueText: "If you'll please excuse me."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She brushed past me and pushed open..."
entries.dialogueText: She brushed past me and pushed open the doors to the trophy room.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A few other guests watched in puzzl..."
entries.dialogueText: A few other guests watched in puzzlement as she picked up her coat and motioned for her husband to leave.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Talking about what? This conversat..."
entries.dialogueText: "Talking about what? This conversation never happened."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My final answer is no. I am sorry.""
entries.dialogueText: "My final answer is no. I am sorry."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She sighed."
entries.dialogueText: She sighed.

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Whatever you say. Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Whatever you say. Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""People will talk no matter what. Y..."
entries.dialogueText: "People will talk no matter what. You know how nobles are."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Right.""
entries.dialogueText: "Right."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She didn't respond."
entries.dialogueText: She didn't respond.

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Yes... yes, I do.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes... yes, I do."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""I'll be ready for it.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'll be ready for it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Afraid your husband will get jealo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Afraid your husband will get jealous?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She laughed politely."
entries.dialogueText: She laughed politely.

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""He and everyone else knows there's..."
entries.dialogueText: "He and everyone else knows there's nothing to be jealous of."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Darling, you know that small talk..."
entries.dialogueText: "Darling, you know that small talk has solved more than one crisis among the Rizian royalty."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""But go on, then. It's all the same..."
entries.dialogueText: "But go on, then. It's all the same to me."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""To be perfectly honest, I'm more a..."
entries.dialogueText: "To be perfectly honest, I'm more afraid of the Queen Consort."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Not my biggest worry right now.""
entries.dialogueText: "Not my biggest worry right now."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We left the trophy room to rejoin t..."
entries.dialogueText: We left the trophy room to rejoin the other guests. A few of them threw curious looks our way.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We left the trophy room to rejoin t..."
entries.dialogueText: We left the trophy room to rejoin the other guests. Manus threw a curious look our way.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""It'll be ready for that when it's..."
entries.dialogueText: "It'll be ready for that when it's ready for democracy. Which is to say, not this century."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Too late for apologies now. You do..."
entries.dialogueText: "Too late for apologies now. You do make quite the fetching couple."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Your crown must be cutting off cir..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your crown must be cutting off circulation to your brain if you believe that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What do you mean, insincere? Every..."
entries.dialogueText: "What do you mean, insincere? Everyone here loves you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""One more distant relative begging..."
entries.dialogueText: "One more distant relative begging me for favors, and I would've joined you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Enough about that. Going public wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Enough about that. Going public with my relationship was my decision to make."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""And my cross to bear.""
entries.dialogueText: "And my cross to bear."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""No matter what our friends outside..."
entries.dialogueText: "No matter what our friends outside have to say about it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I could tell you liked your presen..."
entries.dialogueText: "I could tell you liked your presents."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She lit one of Rusty's cigarettes,..."
entries.dialogueText: She lit one of Rusty's cigarettes, took a drag and exhaled with a sigh. Her other hand went to the pendant the Sazons had given her.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Come on, son. Not you, too.""
entries.dialogueText: "Come on, son. Not you, too."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Ah, but doesn't it feel nice to be..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ah, but doesn't it feel nice to be needed?"

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Our guests' presents were wonderfu..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our guests' presents were wonderful. Their presence, on the other hand..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Personally, I'm very happy with ho..."
entries.dialogueText: "Personally, I'm very happy with how the evening went."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""All three houses in the same room..."
entries.dialogueText: "All three houses in the same room and not a drop of blood shed. You could say that counts as a success."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She lit a cigarette, took a drag an..."
entries.dialogueText: She lit a cigarette, took a drag and exhaled with a sigh. Her other hand went to the pendant the Sazons had given her.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina approached us with a frown."
entries.dialogueText: Vina approached us with a frown.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I've been listening to the talk ar..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've been listening to the talk around the library. It sounds like you got what you were hoping for."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I've been listening to the talk ar..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've been listening to the talk around the library. It sounds like the revolution's days are numbered."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina approached us with a radiant s..."
entries.dialogueText: Vina approached us with a radiant smile.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""It's been a great evening, wouldn'..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's been a great evening, wouldn't you say?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Fantastic, isn't it? The entire Ri..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fantastic, isn't it? The entire Rizian nobility, working as one."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I had to make a lot of promises to..."
entries.dialogueText: "I had to make a lot of promises to a lot of people. I hope it was all worth it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hate the rebels for forcing us d..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hate the rebels for forcing us down this path of violence. If only they'd accepted a peaceful solution."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Indeed. As St. Wruhec wrote, 'Offe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed. As St. Wruhec wrote, 'Offer your enemies kindness, but never your submission."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina approached us with a wary frow..."
entries.dialogueText: Vina approached us with a wary frown.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""You've done a lot of talking this..."
entries.dialogueText: "You've done a lot of talking this evening, Father."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina approached us with a smile."
entries.dialogueText: Vina approached us with a smile.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""You've been making the rounds? I h..."
entries.dialogueText: "You've been making the rounds? I hope it wasn't too exhausting."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""We had a chance for peace. If only..."
entries.dialogueText: "We had a chance for peace. If only you'd listened to Manus--"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Eavesdropping is unbecoming of a p..."
entries.dialogueText: "Eavesdropping is unbecoming of a princess."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Violence is never worth it. If onl..."
entries.dialogueText: "Violence is never worth it. If only you'd listened to Manus--"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Not the *entire* nobility...""
entries.dialogueText: "Not the *entire* nobility..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She looked over at her husband. Man..."
entries.dialogueText: She looked over at her husband. Manus nodded his assent.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She looked over at her husband. He..."
entries.dialogueText: She looked over at her husband. He looked away guiltily.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Hm. We'll talk about this later.""
entries.dialogueText: "Hm. We'll talk about this later."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""But you never offered them kindnes..."
entries.dialogueText: "But you never offered them kindness, did you? Only Manus did, and you never listened--"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She stopped herself as her husband..."
entries.dialogueText: She stopped herself as her husband walked up to us.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's my royal duty to converse wit..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's my royal duty to converse with my subjects at these gatherings. Yours as well, I might add."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes, and what of it?""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, and what of it?"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Nothing...""
entries.dialogueText: "Nothing..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She stopped herself."
entries.dialogueText: She stopped herself.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""One for the history books.""
entries.dialogueText: "One for the history books."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""What? I wasn't eavesdropping.""
entries.dialogueText: "What? I wasn't eavesdropping."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Oh, I've done plenty of conversing.""
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, I've done plenty of conversing."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Her husband walked up to us and sli..."
entries.dialogueText: Her husband walked up to us and slipped his arm through hers.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I've had better.""
entries.dialogueText: "I've had better."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""The reception after my wedding to..."
entries.dialogueText: "The reception after my wedding to your father -- now, that was a party. We were all so blotto, we didn't give a damn where the stars were."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I hope the Azaros had a good time,..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope the Azaros had a good time, despite... never mind."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Good food, scintillating company,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good food, scintillating company, books everywhere -- what's not to like?"

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Is the Party Prince calling it a n..."
entries.dialogueText: "Is the Party Prince calling it a night so soon?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's my royal duty to converse wit..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's my royal duty to converse with my subjects at these gatherings. Yours as well, I might add."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Are you kidding? I could do this a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you kidding? I could do this all night."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I've been conversing. You yourself..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've been conversing. You yourself heard me."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I've been doing my best. But nobod..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've been doing my best. But nobody here has anything interesting to say."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I'm done for, myself. Nobody here..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm done for, myself. Nobody here has anything interesting to say."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What about you? Did you find out a..."
entries.dialogueText: "What about you? Did you find out any juicy gossip?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Her brow wrinkled."
entries.dialogueText: Her brow wrinkled.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Not really...""
entries.dialogueText: "Not really..."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""One of the women who polishes the..."
entries.dialogueText: "One of the women who polishes the silverware caught her husband cheating on her. Other than that, nobody's got anything interesting to say."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Or at least, anything interesting..."
entries.dialogueText: "Or at least, anything interesting to tell me..."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""You throw a good soiree, Your Maje..."
entries.dialogueText: "You throw a good soiree, Your Majesty. Though it would've been nothing without the lady of the hour."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He kissed my mother's hand. She blu..."
entries.dialogueText: He kissed my mother's hand. She blushed.

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Ten more minutes of formalities an..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ten more minutes of formalities and we can get back to our lives, Your Highness."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Vina, sweetheart, you married a ke..."
entries.dialogueText: "Vina, sweetheart, you married a keeper."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""The Sazons thank you for your gene..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Sazons thank you for your generosity, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I can't wait, Your Grace.""
entries.dialogueText: "I can't wait, Your Grace."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I wouldn't be in such a rush to le..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wouldn't be in such a rush to leave, given what's waiting for us outside."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He kept his tone light, but wore a..."
entries.dialogueText: He kept his tone light, but wore a worried expression.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""It's our hope to be invited back n..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's our hope to be invited back next year."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Let's hope so, Grandmother.""
entries.dialogueText: "Let's hope so, Grandmother."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I know, Grandmother.""
entries.dialogueText: "I know, Grandmother."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus was standing nearby, his ear..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus was standing nearby, his ear to his radio.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""The front entrance is compromised,..."
entries.dialogueText: "The front entrance is compromised, Your Majesty. Too many protesters in the square."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""The square is still clear of prote..."
entries.dialogueText: "The square is still clear of protesters, Your Majesty. We've readied the way for your guests' drivers to get through."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""We've readied the way for your gue..."
entries.dialogueText: "We've readied the way for your guests' drivers to pull up to the back entrance."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Much appreciated, Captain.""
entries.dialogueText: "Much appreciated, Captain."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I pray this is the last night we h..."
entries.dialogueText: "I pray this is the last night we have to deal with this nonsense."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I take it nobody in the crowd's be..."
entries.dialogueText: "I take it nobody in the crowd's been injured?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""With luck, this is the last night..."
entries.dialogueText: "With luck, this is the last night we'll have to deal with this nonsense."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""How humiliating.""
entries.dialogueText: "How humiliating."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""We had to forcefully remove a few..."
entries.dialogueText: "We had to forcefully remove a few holdouts. But Nur be praised, no one was hurt."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""We had to forcefully remove a few..."
entries.dialogueText: "We had to forcefully remove a few holdouts. But no one was seriously hurt."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""It's for everybody's safety. Other..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's for everybody's safety. Otherwise we'd never insist upon it."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""No matter what happens, my guards..."
entries.dialogueText: "No matter what happens, my guards will make sure you and your loved ones are safe."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Just doing my job.""
entries.dialogueText: "Just doing my job."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Together with the rest of the Royal..."
entries.dialogueText: Together with the rest of the Royal Family, I made my way to the back of the library.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "One by one, my noble guests said go..."
entries.dialogueText: One by one, my noble guests said goodbye -- some with genuine warmth, others with fake smiles.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Together with the rest of the Royal..."
entries.dialogueText: Together with the rest of the Royal Family, I made my way back to the library foyer.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Every bow, handshake and subtle ges..."
entries.dialogueText: Every bow, handshake and subtle gesture a reminder of a promise made or broken, a bond forged or severed, an ally gained or lost.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Who was still on my side? And would..."
entries.dialogueText: Who was still on my side? And would they stay there in the days and months to come?

entries.title: RiziaDLCText.News_Gossip_Birthday_Protesters = "Even the crowd of spoilsports outside couldn’t throw shade on the night’s proceedings."

entries.title: RiziaDLCText.News_RH_Birthday_War = "Even General Taddeus Azaro took a well-earned break from the Pales war front to attend."
